overall_goal: Transfer, wash, and drain the soaked rice

goals.description: Transfer the soaked rice into a bowl
goals.rationale: The person prepares a strainer and transfers the soaked rice from a tupperware container into a bowl, rinsing the container to ensure all grains are transferred.

goals.description: Wash the rice to remove excess starch
goals.rationale: The person repeatedly fills the bowl with water and rubs the rice by hand to wash it thoroughly.

goals.description: Drain the washed rice using a strainer
goals.rationale: The person pours the washed rice into the strainer, rinses the bowl to collect any remaining grains, and sets the drained rice aside for cooking.
